camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi QueryInstanceBill --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo --BillingCycle '2020-03' --PageNum 1 --PageSize 20 --ProductCode rds --IsHideZeroCharge false --ProductType rds --BillOwnerId 122 --IsBillingItem false --BillingDate '2020-03-03' --Granularity MONTHLY
description_en: Queries the usage summary of all product instances or billable items for an account in a billing cycle. This operation has been upgraded to DescribeInstanceBill. This operation no longer queries data beyond the 50,000th row
description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内所有商品实例或计费项的消费汇总。API 已升级为 DescribeInstanceBill，此API不再提供50000行以后数据的查询
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-instance-bill --billing-cycle 2020-03 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --is-billing-item false --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --is-hide-zero-charge false --billing-date 2020-03-03 --granularity MONTHLY --bill-owner-id 122 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryInstanceBill

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle in YYYY-MM format. Data from the last 18 months is supported
parameters.help_zh: 账期YYYY－MM。仅支持最近18个月账期
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en: The type of the product. Required when the ProductCode parameter is set to the code of an Alibaba Cloud Marketplace product
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型。当ProductCode为云市场产品code时，此参数必填
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:

- Subscription: subscription.

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

> This parameter must be used with the **ProductCode** parameter
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值：
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。

>必须和**ProductCode**参数一起使用
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query data by billable item.

- false: The data is consistent with the bill details on the Instance tab of the Bills page in the User Center.

- true: The data is consistent with the bill details on the Billable Item tab of the Bills page in the User Center.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否按照计费项维度拉取数据。
- false。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-实例”账单一致。
- true。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-计费项”账单一致。

默认 false
parameters.name: is_billing_item

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，默认值：20，最大值：300
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter out bills for which the pretax gross amount (**PretaxGrossAmount**) and pretax amount (**PretaxAmount**) are both 0. Valid values:

- false.

- true
parameters.help_zh:
根据原价（**PretaxGrossAmount**）和应付（**PretaxAmount**）是否都为0做过滤。取值：
- false。
- true
parameters.name: is_hide_zero_charge

parameters.help_en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when the **Granularity** parameter is set to DAILY. The value must be in the YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.help_zh: 账单日期，仅当**Granularity**为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: billing_date

parameters.help_en:
The granularity at which to query bills. Valid values:

- MONTHLY: queries bills by month. The data is consistent with the bill details on the Billing Cycle tab of the Bills page in the User Center.

- DAILY: queries bills by day. The data is consistent with the bill details on the By Day tab of the Bills page in the User Center.

If you set this parameter to DAILY, you must also specify the **BillingDate** parameter
parameters.help_zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值：
- MONTHLY：月。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-账期”账单一致。
- DAILY：日。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-按天”账单一致。

选择DAILY需指定**BillingDate**
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account that owns the resources. This account is the actual user of the resources
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
parameters.name: bill_owner_id
